video_title: Liberty Growing Pains, LeBron's Next Move & Myles' Engagement

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on missing Breanna Stewart's game in Dallas
quotes.excerpt: I had my tickets ready to go. Stewie was supposed to play in Dallas against the Wings.

text_blocks.speaker: Myles Turner
text_blocks.text: I had my tickets ready to go. Stewie was supposed to play in Dallas against the Wings and I had seats to go watch her play this past Sunday, but she didn't make it.

text_blocks.speaker: Breanna Stewart
text_blocks.text: Myles texted me and he was like, 'See you at the game, I'm coming, I got my tickets.' And I was like, 'No, don't come.' We were in New York right now, so I'm not in Dallas.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on the New York Liberty's difficult travel situation
quotes.excerpt: We were waiting there and they were like, 'We need to add more fuel because we're going through a storm.'

text_blocks.speaker: Breanna Stewart
text_blocks.text: We got to the plane and you know how it is, you do your security, get right on the plane. We were waiting there and they were like, 'We need to add more fuel because we're going through a storm.' So we do that. Then this thing is not working. They can't get it fixed. Finally they get it fixed, and now we've already been on the plane for three hours. Then something else breaks.

text_blocks.speaker: Myles Turner
text_blocks.text: This year was the most plane issues I've ever had in my 11 years in the league. Wacking count, I think it was 11 times that we had problems with planes and all similar stuff.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on the New York Liberty's flight cancellation
quotes.excerpt: We're going to get in super late. It's going to be 1:00 a.m. already by the time we land.

text_blocks.speaker: Breanna Stewart
text_blocks.text: We're going to get in super late. It's going to be 1:00 a.m. already by the time we land. And then they're like, 'Well, we don't have any pilots.' Our other pilots timed out, so the pilots timed out and there was no more pilots coming, and they were like, 'This plane is not taking off tonight.'

text_blocks.speaker: Myles Turner
text_blocks.text: I've never been on a plane for 10 hours, bless your heart. That is crazy.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on the technical foul incident involving Marina Mabrey
quotes.excerpt: JJ's shoe fell off and it's a tight moment in the game. I look up and I see a green shoe.

text_blocks.speaker: Breanna Stewart
text_blocks.text: JJ's shoe fell off and it's a tight moment in the game. We're trying to come back. We get a stop and all of a sudden I look up and I see a green shoe flying through the air. And then it hit Marina Mabrey and I'm like, 'Oh my god.'

text_blocks.speaker: Myles Turner
text_blocks.text: May or may not have thrown a stone, a projectile at Marina Mabrey and that was pretty interesting.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on fan voting for WNBA All-Star starters
quotes.excerpt: Thank you to the fans, because you know fan voting is majority of what gets All-Star starting.
quotes.quote: I would like to say thank you to the fans, because you know fan voting is majority of what gets All-Star starting. I'm really happy and honored to always continue to be representing the league and it's just the work that continues to shine through and push through.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart on the WNBA's All-Star selection process
quotes.excerpt: Before when the league started, they didn't count Olympic team as an All-Star because they just took the break.
quotes.quote: Before when the league started, they didn't count Olympic team as an All-Star because they just took the break, so then there never was an All-Star. So for my first two, there was just no All-Star. I was on Candace's and Aliyah's podcast the other day and Candace is a seven-timer, eight-time All-Star and she should be like a 10, 11 based on how many team USA's she's played and things like that. So it's a little bit skewed, but whatever, we're getting up there.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on LeBron James' free agency and contract situation
quotes.excerpt: Even at his bronze age, he still wants to get paid. He still wants to make sure he has an opportunity.
quotes.quote: It's obviously interesting, because even at his bronze age, he still wants to get paid. He still wants to make sure he has an opportunity to go out on the right terms and win. It's tough the way the league's been doing our stars lately when it comes to their exits. We kind of saw the Carmelo Anthony treatment, kind of what he got. These guys retire and it's not like a real farewell tour. It's almost like a get the fuck out of here tour. LeBron is one of the best, if not the greatest player of our generation and puts his argument in there for all time.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on LeBron James potentially joining the Cleveland Cavaliers
quotes.excerpt: I think for someone like himself, Cleveland makes sense. You go out playing for your hometown team.
quotes.quote: I think for someone like himself, Cleveland makes sense. You go out playing for your hometown team, win a championship for that team. I think it's good for the league personally if he makes that move. My sleeper choice would be the Sixers just because that's going to get the most hype, where he kind of does have a chance to go out there and be competitive.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on the 2023 NBA Draft class
quotes.excerpt: I was bummed when Caleb Wilson didn't play at the end of the year last year.
quotes.quote: It's been fun. I think this is a really good draft class. I was bummed when Caleb Wilson didn't play at the end of the year last year. He's one of my favorite players to watch in college. He's got the right mentality, he's got the right frame and he's a dog. He plays at a really high level right now. I think Cameron Boozer is as good as advertised. There's another players with solid over there in Memphis as well.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on Graham Ike's potential
quotes.excerpt: Another guy I really like, sleeper, might not have watched him too much is Graham Ike.
quotes.quote: Another guy I really like, sleeper, might not have watched him too much is Graham Ike. He's playing over there, he's from Gonzaga. He's a big man and he's playing really well over there on the West Coast. I think that he's someone that didn't get a chance to really get to shine through as much as he wanted to through the draft, but he went undrafted and I think he's playing at an extremely high level on both ends of the floor.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on the San Antonio Spurs' free agency strategy
quotes.excerpt: That formula just worked. Jalen Brunson just did it and New York Knicks won the finals.
quotes.quote: That formula just worked. Jalen Brunson just did it and New York Knicks won the finals. By Jalen Brunson being able to do it, they were able to bring in free agents and resign some guys to build a team around him. He's someone who has been deserving of money for a long time, but he decided not to so let his team build around him. I think San Antonio is trying to take the same approach. San Antonio is in my opinion a very attractive free agent destination just because of how well the organization has created a reputation for itself.
